akrapovic-racing-line-carbon-kawasaki-ni.d: This product is constructed with hand-laid carbon fibre for the muffler outer sleeve and end cap, with a high-grade stainless-steel inner structure, noise insert, link pipe, and headers, resulting in a race track use–oriented exhaust that is 68.6% (8.3 kg) lighter that the standard stock version. Maximum performance is obtained due to a different exhaust configuration, creating performance gains throughout the entire rev range above 5,000 rpm. Power and torque increases of 5.7 kW (7.7 hp) at 13,200 rpm and 7.7 Nm at 6,000 rpm have been recorded, respectively, when compared to a Kawasaki Ninja ZX-6R equipped with a standard stock exhaust and tested on the Akrapovič dyno. The racing look is due to removal of the pre-muffler; the exhaust has two lambda sensors to counter this. The exhaust tone has a unique deep racing sound, and the system is a plug-and-play installation that requires no mandatory remapping, but this is recommended to get the full experience. Options include a carbon-fibre muffler bracket and the Track Day Link Pipe (SS) to use on race tracks with stricter noise limits. THIS PRODUCT DOES NOT MEET EMISSION COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS FOR STREET OR HIGHWAY USE. The product is developed and tested on EU vehicle specification. Non-EU fitment and performance may vary by marketplace and different vehicle specification.

daytona-stovel-evo-voltex-sv-gra.d: Mycket säker racingstövel i den unika 2-skalstekniken som bara hittas hos daytona®. Innersko i hårdplast med rörlig led. Inredd med svettabsorberande textil (80% polyamid/20% polyester. Stötabsorberande inlägg av latex vid häl, fotled samt vad. Anatomiskt utformad sfärisk hälbädd. Yttersko i slitstarkt vattenavstötande nötläder med yttre plastförstärkningar på utsatta platser. Kardborrejustering vid skaftet för att anpassa vadvidden samt stängning via dragkedja. Stretchpaneler bättre passform och lättare insteg samt förstärkning i slitstarkt pu-skum vid växelspak. Skydd för skenben med vaddering samt luftintag för ökad ventilation. Sula i pu-skum och plast som förstärkts med galvaniserat stål vilken gör den vridstyv men ändå gångvänlig. Racingsula med extra rundad carbon-häl och försedd med utbytbar tåslider av titan samt reflex från 3M Scotchlite. Skafthöjd ca. 32 cm.
